meta.name: Indica
meta.one_line_vibe: Denver house with a basement cinema and a hot tub for unwinding.

arrival.code_delivery: Sent the morning of your arrival. Activates at 4:00 PM unless early check-in has been approved.
arrival.lock_backup_tip: After entering your code, press the 'Check' (or 'Schlage') button to engage the lock. If the door doesn't open, try again slowly, one digit at a time.
arrival.parking: PLEASE DO NOT BLOCK NEIGHBORING DRIVEWAYS. Please access the driveway and park in front of the garage. You may also park along the road in front of the property.
arrival.towels_location: 8 towels in the closet of the upstairs room, plus 8 more on top of the washing machine in the downstairs room.
first_steps: Please take luggage directly to your bedroom to protect the floors.
Fire extinguishers are in every bedroom and beneath the kitchen sink.
Front and back doors are the two main exits.

wifi.notes: If slow: unplug the router for 30 sec and plug back in.
wifi.router_location: Living room, behind the dining table

house_rules: Feel free to smoke 420 indoors. Tobacco goes outside, please ($1,000 reset fee if it doesn't).
Quiet hours run 10 PM to 9 AM so the neighbors can rest easy.
Pets are welcome. Keep them off the furniture and clean up after them ($200 if we find a surprise).
Please check with us before adding guests or hosting a party. Unapproved gatherings cancel the stay.
The hot tub and cup holders are not ashtrays ($50 cleanup fee per incident).

quick_start: Flip the hot tub switch on; allow 30+ min to reach temp
Open all jet valves before running the jets
Press the Light button once on the control panel (if you want the LED on)
Close the cover when not in use
hot_tub.water_care: Shock every 2–3 days for light use, or after each heavy / long soak. No food, drinks, glass, or smoking in the water.
rules: No food, drinks, or glass in the tub
Keep water above the filter line, drops below = heater shuts off

grill.notes: Propane grill is available. Bring your own propane or order a tank through the Cynch app.

theater_room.seating: 6-seater electronic recliners, controls on the right-hand side of each seat. One adult or child per seat. No rough play. Children must not be left unattended.
theater_room.projector: Use the remote controls to adjust the projector and Roku stick. The projector requires no adjustments on arrival. For an external device, bring an HDMI cable long enough to reach with slack, if there's no slack, the cable is too short.
theater_room.streaming: Roku stick included, sign in with your own streaming accounts and sign out before checkout.
popcorn_machine_steps: Turn both 'light' and 'pop' switches on and preheat for 2–3 minutes
Open the lid carefully and add oil plus a small measure of kernels
Once popping ceases, turn off the machine promptly to prevent burning
Supervise children, the machine gets VERY HOT

game_room.notes: Living area amenities. Children must be supervised, do not leave them unattended in this space.

ignition_steps: Open the propane tank valve by twisting the knob to the open position
Follow the manual inside the pit for ignition specifics
Rotate the knob to the lightning bolt symbol and press it down while clicking the starter button
Allow 15–30 seconds for gas to prime and ignite
Once lit, adjust the gas setting to low or high based on preference
firepit.shutdown: Turn off the pit and close the propane tank when not in use. Keep the pit covered when not in use.

streaming: Sign in with your own accounts
tv.notes: Log out of all streaming apps before checkout.

highlights: Full kitchen, cook what you'd cook at home
Delivery works great: Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub

hair_dryer.location: Under each bathroom sink (one per bathroom)
hair_dryer.notes: If one is missing, message us and we will bring one over.

steps: Bag the trash and move it to the bins near the front entrance
Sign out of any streaming apps on the TVs
Set the hallway thermostat to 66°F in winter, 75°F in summer
Lock up behind you and have a safe trip
checkout.trash_day: Monday. Bins are on the side of the house. Our team comes by to take the trash out and bring the bins back in, nothing for you to do.

temperature.winter_minimum: 66°F, required to prevent pipes from freezing
temperature.notes: Thermostat controls both heat and A/C, adjust freely

eat_in_10.name: Doug's Diner
eat_in_10.reason: Family-owned since 2010. Scratch-made, cooked in real butter, served in nap-worthy portions.

eat_in_10.name: Bluebird Cafe
eat_in_10.reason: The old Egg & I reborn. Fresh local ingredients, gluten-free and vegetarian options.

coffee.name: Summer Moon Coffee
coffee.reason: Unique oak-roasting technique that produces a flavor worth trying at least once. Pet-friendly patio.

casual_dinner.name: Jim's Burger Haven
casual_dinner.reason: Denver's original smash burger, in business since 1961. Colorado-raised Angus and never frozen.

casual_dinner.name: Tequila's Family Mexican
casual_dinner.reason: Family-run for over eighteen years. Serious tequila and mezcal list if you want to make an evening of it.

casual_dinner.name: Saigon Bowl
casual_dinner.reason: Widely considered the best pho in Thornton. Twenty years of Vietnamese cooking behind every bowl.

parks.name: Trail Winds Park
parks.reason: 111 acres of trails and open space. Easy to walk, run, or spend a slow morning.

parks.name: Pecos Park
parks.reason: A compact nine-acre park. Good for a quick stroll or a short run.

adventure_day.name: Red Rocks Amphitheatre
adventure_day.reason: One of the great outdoor venues in the country. Free to walk and hike, even without a show.

adventure_day.name: Rocky Mountain National Park
adventure_day.reason: The classic Colorado day. Elk, alpine lakes, and Trail Ridge Road.

adventure_day.name: Boulder / Flatirons
adventure_day.reason: College town energy and iconic rock formations for photos.

late_night.name: Fat Shack
late_night.reason: Open when almost nothing else is. A reliable answer to the 'what now?' question at 1 AM.

late_night.name: Waffle House
late_night.reason: Open twenty-four hours. If it's 2 AM and you're hungry, this is the answer.

late_night.name: In-N-Out Burger
late_night.reason: Fresh off the grill until late. Order the Double-Double animal-style at least once.

host_picks.name: Brooklyn's Finest Pizza
host_picks.meta: Pizza · Host's pick · 10 min · 5 mi · Denver
host_picks.body: Host's favorite pizza in the city. New York style by the slice or full pie.
host_picks.order: Pepperoni slice, white pie, garlic knots.

host_picks.name: Blue Agave
host_picks.body: Go-to for margaritas and fajitas. Upbeat vibe, generous portions, tableside guac.
host_picks.order: Sizzling fajitas, street tacos, tableside guac.

host_picks.name: Welton Street Cafe
host_picks.meta: Soul Food · Five Points · 10 min · 5 mi · 2670 Welton St
host_picks.body: Southern soul food in historic Five Points. Family-run, full plates, a Denver institution.
host_picks.order: Fried chicken, mac and cheese, collards, sweet potato pie.

host_picks.name: Thai Daughter
host_picks.body: Local favorite Thai spot. Order it medium-hot, they don't skimp on heat.
host_picks.order: Pad Thai, drunken noodles, Massaman curry.

host_picks.name: Gaetano's
host_picks.meta: Italian · Old-school · 7 min · 2.5 mi · 3760 Tejon St
host_picks.body: Classic red-sauce Italian in the Highlands. Family vibes, a bar with stories, lasagna for a cold night.

host_picks.name: Yard House
host_picks.meta: Sports Bar · 100+ beers · 12 min · 6 mi · Downtown
host_picks.body: Solid spot to watch a game. Huge beer list, big TVs, full pub menu.
host_picks.order: Truffle fries, nachos, half-pound burger, draft flight.

host_picks.name: Denver Biscuit Company
host_picks.meta: Brunch · Southern · 14 min · 7 mi · 3237 E Colfax
host_picks.body: Hand-sized biscuits and fried chicken that hits every time. Real brunch.

host_picks.name: Rooftop · Night Out
host_picks.body: Host's pick for a club night. Rooftop vibes, DJ sets on weekends, dress code applies.

troubleshooting.fix: Unplug the router for 30 seconds, plug back in, wait 2 min.
Switch input to HDMI 1 using the TV remote (not the Roku remote).
Check the breaker panel, HVAC breaker may have tripped.

how_to_claim: Post a photo from your stay tagged #Kushkations and #KushKations
Leave a five-star review on your booking platform
Email a screenshot to info@kushkations.com, we'll send the code

cleaner_notes: Confirm hot tub is in ST mode after every clean, not EC
Reset thermostat to 68°F after clean, not lower
Empty trash bins and replace liners

tasks: Wipe front door handle and lock panel
Restock paper towels, dish soap, sponge
Check TV remotes in each room
Restock toilet paper (3+ rolls per bath)
Check hair on floor and drains
All trash bagged at outdoor bins

utilities.breaker_panel: Right next to the door to the backyard, beside the stairs going down to the basement
utilities.water_shutoff: Basement cinema room, near the popcorn machine, behind a white cover
utilities.wifi_router: Living room, behind the dining table
